title: Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree
exact_target: For each fixed integer $d>=3$, is there a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that, for every sufficiently large even n, constructs a simple connected nonbipartite d-regular graph on n vertices with all nontrivial adjacency eigenvalues of absolute value at most 2 sqrt(d-1)?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
For each fixed integer $d>=3$, is there a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that, for every sufficiently large even n, constructs a simple connected nonbipartite d-regular graph on n vertices with all nontrivial adjacency eigenvalues of absolute value at most 2 sqrt(d-1)?

\subsection{Short English statement}
For each fixed integer $d>=3$, is there a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that, for every sufficiently large even n, constructs a simple connected nonbipartite d-regular graph on n vertices with all nontrivial adjacency eigenvalues of absolute value at most 2 sqrt(d-1)?
